base=[np.ones_like(t),P,P**2,t,t*P,1/P,np.log(P),P*np.log(P)]
def e_w(w, extra):
    s=np.sin(w*t); c_=np.cos(w*t)
    cols=base+[s,c_]+extra(s,c_)
    A=np.column_stack(cols); c=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dP_dt,rcond=None)[0]
    r=dP_dt-A@c; return np.mean(r**2)/np.var(dP_dt), c

from scipy.optimize import least_squares
def model(p,t,P):
    a,c,d,e,f,g,h,k,m,w=p
    s=np.sin(w*t); cc=np.cos(w*t)
    return a + c*P*np.log(P) + d/P + e*t + f*t/P + (g*s + h*cc + k*t*s + m*t*cc)/P

def colsw(w):
    s=np.sin(w*t); c_=np.cos(w*t)
    return np.column_stack([np.ones_like(t),t,P**2,P*np.log(P),1/P,t/P,s/P,c_/P,t*s/P,t*c_/P])
def cost(w):
    A=colsw(w); c=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dP_dt,rcond=None)[0]
    return np.mean((dP_dt-A@c)**2)/np.var(dP_dt), c

import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    a,b,c,d,e,f,g,w = params[0],params[1],params[2],params[3],params[4],params[5],params[6],params[7]
    s=np.sin(w*t); cc=np.cos(w*t)
    return a + b*t + c*P*np.log(P) + d/P + f*t/P + (e*s + g*cc)/P
